orientation.description: Defines the orientation of the layout.

intraShapeSpacing.description: The spacing buffer added between shapes on the same layer. Default is 30.

interRankShapeSpacing.description: The spacing buffer added between shape on adjacent layers. Default is 150.

interHierarchySpacing.description: The spacing buffer between unconnected hierarchies. Default is 60.

parallelEdgeSpacing.description: The distance between each parallel edge on each ranks for long edges. Default is 10.

maintainHiddenShapesLocation.description:
Whether to maintain hidden shapes location.
When a node is hidden and its descendants become root, they will be moved to the left or top depending on the orientation.
